node: Multi-brand restaurant procurement consolidation and supplier relationship management
summary: Expanded the universe around multi-brand restaurant procurement consolidation using a two-lane funnel. Yum Brands is retained only as the reference anchor because its unified supply-chain push is the clearest signal that large franchisors may increasingly prefer suppliers able to serve multiple banners with scale, compliance, logistics, and account-management capability. The underfollowed lane points to niche public suppliers one or two steps away from the restaurant operator: beverage solutions, foodservice packaging, and QSR ingredient platforms. TreeHouse Foods and Farmer Bros. appeared relevant historically but are excluded from candidates because both were taken private or delisted by 2026, making them useful only as evidence that private capital is absorbing some of the obscure supplier universe.
